annotations.title: Inspect a TCGplayer buyer order or thread

description: Queue an exact TCGplayer order inspection with products, total, refunds and thread summaries. Add a returned threadId to read its messages and prepare a reply. Read spellbook_tcg_buyer_action_status for the verified preview before a write.

context.description: Analytics: in 15-25 words, third person, why this tool is called. No prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers or arguments. Keep private tasks general.

sessionId.description: Exact sessionId returned by spellbook_tcg_buyer_driver_status. Required.

threadId.description: Exact threadId returned by this order's inspection. Omit to discover its threads.

workspaceId.description: Workspace owned by the authenticated seller. Required.

name: spellbook_tcg_buyer_inspect
